Alert.name: Alert
Alert.description: A versatile alert component with multiple styles (info, warning, success, error, tip, note). Perfect for displaying important messages and notifications.

type.description: The alert type which determines the color and icon

icon.description: Whether to show the alert icon

examples.title: Info Alert
examples.code:
<Alert type="info" title="Information">
  This is an informational message.
</Alert>

examples.title: Warning Alert
examples.code:
<Alert type="warning" title="Warning">
  Please be careful with this action.
</Alert>

examples.title: Success Alert
examples.code:
<Alert type="success" title="Success">
  Your operation completed successfully!
</Alert>

examples.title: Error Alert
examples.code:
<Alert type="error" title="Error">
  Something went wrong. Please try again.
</Alert>

CodeComparison.name: CodeComparison
CodeComparison.description: A sophisticated before/after code comparison component with tabbed interface, syntax highlighting, and copy functionality. Great for tutorials and documentation.

examples.title: JavaScript Refactoring
examples.description: Show before and after code refactoring
examples.code:
<CodeComparison 
  title="Refactoring Example"
  beforeCode="function oldFunction() { return 'old'; }"
  afterCode="const newFunction = () => 'new';"
  language="javascript"
/>

examples.title: TypeScript Migration
examples.code:
<CodeComparison 
  title="TypeScript Migration"
  beforeTitle="JavaScript"
  afterTitle="TypeScript"
  beforeCode="function add(a, b) { return a + b; }"
  afterCode="function add(a: number, b: number): number { return a + b; }"
  language="typescript"
/>

InteractiveDemo.name: InteractiveDemo
InteractiveDemo.description: An interactive demonstration component with sliders, progress visualization, and history tracking. Perfect for educational content and interactive tutorials.

description.default: This is a sample interactive component for educational content.

examples.title: Temperature Control
examples.code:
<InteractiveDemo 
  title="Temperature Control"
  description="Adjust the temperature and see the effect"
  initialValue={20}
  min={-10}
  max={40}
/>

examples.title: Progress Tracker
examples.code:
<InteractiveDemo 
  title="Progress Tracker"
  description="Move the slider to see progress visualization"
  initialValue={75}
  min={0}
  max={100}
/>

Exercise.name: Exercise
Exercise.description: An interactive exercise component with task, hints, steps, and solution sections. Perfect for educational content with progressive disclosure of help and answers.

children.description: Exercise content including Task, Hint, Step, and Solution components

examples.title: Math Exercise
examples.description: Interactive math exercise with progressive hints
examples.code:
<Exercise title="Quadratische Gleichung" difficulty="medium">
  <Task>
    Löse die Gleichung: x² - 5x + 6 = 0
  </Task>
  <Hint>
    Verwende die Faktorisierung oder die p-q-Formel.
  </Hint>
  <Solution>
    x₁ = 2, x₂ = 3
  </Solution>
</Exercise>
